items.text: Once there were twenty five tin soldiers. <break time="0.8s" /> In a wooden box. <break time="0.8s" /> They were all brothers. <break time="0.8s" /> Because they were made. <break time="0.8s" /> From one old spoon. <break time="0.8s" /> Tin soldiers. <break time="0.8s" /> Shouted a little boy. <break time="0.8s" /> When he opened the box. <break time="0.8s" /> They were his birthday present. <break time="0.8s" /> And he was very happy. <break time="0.8s" /> The soldiers wore. <break time="0.8s" /> Red and blue uniforms. <break time="0.8s" /> And carried guns. <break time="0.8s" /> On their shoulders. <break time="0.8s" /> They all looked the same. <break time="0.8s" /> Except for the last soldier. <break time="0.8s" /> He had only one leg. <break time="0.8s" /> Because there was not enough tin. <break time="0.8s" /> But he stood on one leg. <break time="0.8s" /> As firmly as the others stood on two. <break time="0.8s" /> On the table. <break time="0.8s" /> There were many other toys. <break time="0.8s" /> To play with. <break time="0.8s" /> The most wonderful toy of all. <break time="0.8s" /> Was a paper castle. <break time="0.8s" /> Through its little windows. <break time="0.8s" /> You could see into the rooms.

옛날에 있었다 주석 병정 스물다섯 명이. <break time="0.8s" /> 나무 상자 안에. <break time="0.8s" /> 그들은 모두 형제였다. <break time="0.8s" /> 왜냐하면 그들은 만들어졌기 때문이다. <break time="0.8s" /> 낡은 숟가락 하나로. <break time="0.8s" /> 주석 병정이다. <break time="0.8s" /> 한 어린 소년이 외쳤다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그가 상자를 열었을 때. <break time="0.8s" /> 그것은 그의 생일 선물이었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 그는 무척 기뻤다. <break time="0.8s" /> 병정들은 입었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 빨간색과 파란색 제복을. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 총을 메었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 어깨에. <break time="0.8s" /> 그들은 모두 똑같아 보였다. <break time="0.8s" /> 마지막 병정만 빼고. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 다리가 하나뿐이었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 주석이 충분하지 않았기 때문이다. <break time="0.8s" /> 하지만 그는 한 다리로 섰다. <break time="0.8s" /> 꼭 그만큼 꼿꼿하게 다른 병정들이 두 다리로 서는 것만큼. <break time="0.8s" /> 탁자 위에는. <break time="0.8s" /> 다른 장난감이 많이 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 가지고 놀. <break time="0.8s" /> 그중에서 가장 멋진 장난감은. <break time="0.8s" /> 종이 성이었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그 작은 창문들을 통해. <break time="0.8s" /> 방 안을 들여다볼 수 있었다.

In front of the castle. <break time="0.8s" /> Little trees stood. <break time="0.8s" /> Around a small mirror. <break time="0.8s" /> The mirror looked like a lake. <break time="0.8s" /> And wax swans. <break time="0.8s" /> Were swimming on it. <break time="0.8s" /> In the open door of the castle. <break time="0.8s" /> Stood a pretty little lady. <break time="0.8s" /> She was a dancer. <break time="0.8s" /> And she was cut out of paper too. <break time="0.8s" /> She wore a dress. <break time="0.8s" /> Of thin cloth. <break time="0.8s" /> And a narrow blue ribbon. <break time="0.8s" /> In the middle. <break time="0.8s" /> Was a shiny spangle. <break time="0.8s" /> As big as her face. <break time="0.8s" /> She was holding out both arms. <break time="0.8s" /> Because she was dancing. <break time="0.8s" /> She was kicking one leg up. <break time="0.8s" /> So high. <break time="0.8s" /> That he could not see it. <break time="0.8s" /> She has only one leg. <break time="0.8s" /> Just like me. <break time="0.8s" /> Thought the soldier. <break time="0.8s" /> But she lives in a castle. <break time="0.8s" /> And I only have a box. <break time="0.8s" /> He lay down. <break time="0.8s" /> Behind a snuffbox on the table. <break time="0.8s" /> To watch her.

성 앞에는. <break time="0.8s" /> 작은 나무들이 서 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 작은 거울을 둘러싸고. <break time="0.8s" /> 거울은 호수처럼 보였다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 밀랍 백조들이. <break time="0.8s" /> 그 위에서 헤엄치고 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 성의 열린 문에. <break time="0.8s" /> 예쁜 작은 아가씨가 서 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그녀는 무용수였다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 그녀 역시 종이를 오려 만들어졌다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그녀는 드레스를 입었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 얇은 천으로 된. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 좁은 파란 리본을 걸쳤다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그 한가운데에는. <break time="0.8s" /> 반짝이는 장식이 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그녀의 얼굴만큼 큰. <break time="0.8s" /> 그녀는 두 팔을 뻗고 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 왜냐하면 그녀는 춤추고 있었기 때문이다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그녀는 한쪽 다리를 차올리고 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 아주 높이. <break time="0.8s" /> 그래서 그는 그것을 볼 수 없었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그녀도 다리가 하나뿐이구나. <break time="0.8s" /> 꼭 나처럼. <break time="0.8s" /> 병정은 생각했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 하지만 그녀는 성에 산다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 나에게는 상자 하나뿐이다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 누웠다. <break time="0.8s" /> 탁자 위 코담배 상자 뒤에. <break time="0.8s" /> 그녀를 바라보려고.

In the evening the other soldiers. <break time="0.8s" /> Were put back into their box. <break time="0.8s" /> When the people went to bed. <break time="0.8s" /> The toys began to play. <break time="0.8s" /> The nutcracker was turning somersaults. <break time="0.8s" /> And the pencil was drawing. <break time="0.8s" /> On the slate. <break time="0.8s" /> The canary woke up. <break time="0.8s" /> And began to talk in poems. <break time="0.8s" /> Only the tin soldier and the dancer. <break time="0.8s" /> Did not move at all. <break time="0.8s" /> She stayed on the tip of her toe. <break time="0.8s" /> And he stayed on his one leg. <break time="0.8s" /> He did not take his eyes off her. <break time="0.8s" /> Even for a moment. <break time="0.8s" /> At midnight. <break time="0.8s" /> The lid of the snuffbox. <break time="0.8s" /> Flew open. <break time="0.8s" /> There was no snuff inside. <break time="0.8s" /> Only a little black goblin. <break time="0.8s" /> Tin soldier. <break time="0.8s" /> Stop looking at what is not yours. <break time="0.8s" /> Said the goblin. <break time="0.8s" /> The soldier pretended not to hear. <break time="0.8s" /> So the goblin said. <break time="0.8s" /> Just wait until tomorrow.

저녁에 다른 병정들은. <break time="0.8s" /> 다시 상자 속에 넣어졌다. <break time="0.8s" /> 사람들이 잠자리에 들었을 때. <break time="0.8s" /> 장난감들이 놀기 시작했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 호두까기 인형은 재주넘기를 하고 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 연필은 그리고 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 석판 위에. <break time="0.8s" /> 카나리아가 잠에서 깼다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 시로 말하기 시작했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 오직 주석 병정과 발레리나만. <break time="0.8s" /> 전혀 움직이지 않았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그녀는 발끝으로 서 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 그는 한 다리로 서 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 그녀에게서 눈을 떼지 않았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 한순간도. <break time="0.8s" /> 한밤중에. <break time="0.8s" /> 코담배 상자의 뚜껑이. <break time="0.8s" /> 휙 열렸다. <break time="0.8s" /> 안에는 코담배가 없었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 작고 검은 도깨비 인형만 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 주석 병정. <break time="0.8s" /> 네 것이 아닌 것을 그만 쳐다봐. <break time="0.8s" /> 도깨비가 말했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 병정은 못 들은 척했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그러자 도깨비가 말했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 내일까지 기다려 봐.

The next morning. <break time="0.8s" /> The little boy put the soldier. <break time="0.8s" /> On the windowsill. <break time="0.8s" /> Suddenly the window flew open. <break time="0.8s" /> And the soldier fell. <break time="0.8s" /> From the third floor. <break time="0.8s" /> Nobody knows. <break time="0.8s" /> If it was the wind. <break time="0.8s" /> Or the goblin. <break time="0.8s" /> The maid and the little boy. <break time="0.8s" /> Went down. <break time="0.8s" /> To look for him. <break time="0.8s" /> He did not shout. <break time="0.8s" /> Because he was a soldier. <break time="0.8s" /> In uniform. <break time="0.8s" /> Then it began to rain. <break time="0.8s" /> Harder and harder. <break time="0.8s" /> After the rain. <break time="0.8s" /> Two street boys. <break time="0.8s" /> Found the soldier. <break time="0.8s" /> They made a boat. <break time="0.8s" /> Out of newspaper. <break time="0.8s" /> And put him in it. <break time="0.8s" /> The boat floated down the gutter. <break time="0.8s" /> And into a long, dark tunnel. <break time="0.8s" /> A big water rat jumped out. <break time="0.8s" /> And shouted. <break time="0.8s" /> Show me your passport. <break time="0.8s" /> But the soldier said nothing. <break time="0.8s" /> And held his gun more tightly.
